description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Founding Engineer focused on AI and machine learning, you will own the intelligence layer of an AI recruiting marketplace. You will build recommendation, ranking, retrieval, and LLM-powered matching systems that help connect candidates with relevant roles.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own recommendation, ranking, and retrieval systems from design through production.

 - Build and improve LLM-powered matching features, measuring their impact on candidate-role alignment.

 - Take product features from problem definition to production and ship improvements at a rapid pace.

 - Architect and maintain the data pipelines and production services that support machine learning models.

 - Work directly with company leadership to turn product goals into deployed systems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of experience building and shipping end-to-end software features in production.

 - Hands-on experience building recommendation, ranking, or machine learning-based matching systems for real users.

 - Experience building LLM API-powered features and shipping machine learning models or products to production.

 - Strong production engineering skills in TypeScript or Python, along with experience using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent frameworks.

 - Experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and services, with strong computer science fundamentals.

 - More than six months of substantive work experience in the United States, plus a substantive machine learning role at a recognized product company or credible startup.

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with frequent iteration and daily shipping.

 - Demonstrated technical achievement through strong open-source contributions, notable personal projects, or comparable accomplishments.

 - React experience is helpful, as is familiarity with Supabase, Prisma, database design, Typesense or similar search infrastructure, embeddings, vector search, and workflow automation tools.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $170,000 annually, plus founding-hire equity. Visa sponsorship is available for candidates eligible for a supported sponsorship route.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, six days per week. Candidates must be based in San Francisco or willing to relocate.
